About Flow

Flow is a layer-1 blockchain created by Dapper Labs for consumer apps, games and NFTs (such as NBA Top Shot). FLOW pays fees and secures the network.

Where this FLOW price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (FLOW-USD), Binance (FLOW/USDT) and Kraken (FLOW/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 1.61B FLOW (supply last updated October 30, 2026).
